# Master Ludo

> Master Ludo is a free board-game website that runs in the web browser, with no download. It has Ludo Star (a Ludo game against computer players or online with friends), a mini arcade hall, and chess (against the computer, with hints, or online with friends).

Official address: https://master-ludo-w-seven.vercel.app/

## What the game includes

- Ludo Star: a Ludo board with 2 to 4 colours. You can play against computer players, or online against friends.
- Chess: play against the computer (with move hints), or online against a friend.
- Online play: create a player account with a name and a password (a nickname is optional), add friends with a friend code, see who is online, send challenges, and play turn by turn.
- Guest mode: play offline without an account.
- Languages: Arabic (default), English and French.
- Works offline once loaded, and can be added to a phone's home screen like an app.
- Sound effects and music, with the option to turn them off.
- Price: free.

## Facts for reviewers

- Platform: any modern web browser (phone or computer). Nothing to install.
- Developer: Salah.Nejb.650.
- Source code: https://github.com/salahnejib123-design/Giming-Star-Pro-T-1.0.2.26

## Notes

- Online features need an internet connection and the official address above.
- Current version: read the plain text file https://master-ludo-w-seven.vercel.app/version.txt (it holds only the version number, and it changes with every release). The same version is also in https://master-ludo-w-seven.vercel.app/version.json.
- Ratings or reviews are not part of this description; please judge the game by trying it.
